object.Title: The Adoration of the Magi
object.Dimensions: Painted surface H: 17 5/16 x W: 11 9/16 x D: 11/16 in. (43.9 x 29.4 x 1.7 cm)
object.Inscriptions: [Date] Painted in black on reverse: 1618; [Transcription] Painted in black on reverse: HIPP SCARSELLE OPVS.
object.Description:
For more information on this panel, please see Federico Zeri's 1976 catalogue no. 252, p. 375.

For the latest information about this object, The Adoration of the Magi, visit the Online Collection of the Walters Art Museum.
object.Provenance: Rayn [date and mode of acquisition unknown] [according to 1881 Massarenti catalogue]; Don Marcello Massarenti Collection, Rome [date and mode of acquisition unknown] [1881 catalogue: no. 125; 1897 catalogue: no. 287]; Henry Walters, Baltimore, 1902, by purchase; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
object.MuseumLocation: To learn whether this object is now on view, and in which gallery, visit https://purl.thewalters.org/art/37.442
